original_mechanism: The terminal proxy initially concatenated a user-controlled path without confinement; a later one-pass unquote mitigation still allowed encoded traversal.
original_sink: backend/open_webui/routers/terminals.py proxy_terminal target_url passed to aiohttp.ClientSession.request

attempted_remediation.changed: Replaced the single unquote with a decode-until-stable loop capped at eight.
attempted_remediation.missed: After eight unquote passes the function still forwarded a still-encoded path.

residual_bypass: Nine-times encoded ../ exited the cap-8 loop and was decoded upstream.

final_closure.closed: Fail-closed if unquote still changed the path after the cap.

original_mechanism: The permission-save endpoint exposed unauthenticated role-permission mutations without an authorization decision for the submitted target role.

attempted_remediation.missed: Added no authorization check for the submitted target role and permissions.

residual_bypass: Any authenticated user could grant permissions to an arbitrary role.

final_closure.closed: Added PermissionSaveRequest authorization restricted to SuperAdmin and validated role inputs.

original_mechanism: Uploaded files could be linked to draft releases and served by UUID without the write permission required for draft content.
original_sink: Gitea release attachment creation/linkage and UUID-based web /attachments/:uuid download route

attempted_remediation.changed: Added canAccessDraftRelease to API release and attachment endpoints.
attempted_remediation.missed: Did not add the draft gate to the UUID-based web download routes.

residual_bypass: An anonymous user with an attachment UUID could download a draft artifact.

final_closure.closed: Added IsDraft plus write-permission enforcement to web ServeAttachment and its backport.

original_mechanism: Deeply nested expressions could exhaust the parser stack because recursive expression paths had no enforcing depth boundary.
original_sink: Scriban Parser.Expressions ParseExpression recursion through array, parenthesis, object, and unary paths

attempted_remediation.changed: Wrapped ParseArrayInitializer with the existing expression-depth accounting guard and added a shallow error-only test.
attempted_remediation.missed: The existing guard logged a non-fatal error and did not stop recursive descent.

residual_bypass: Nested expressions could keep recursing after the configured depth limit.

final_closure.closed: Stopped shared parser control flow when the depth limit is exceeded and checked the remaining execution stack.
